flags.item: Pinnacle publishes each LoL series twice and the pick engine was using the (Kills) derivative [verified live 2026-10-23 (both matchup ids visible in one Pinnacle response)]
flags.detail: Pinnacle's guest API lists a series moneyline plus a parallel '(Kills)' market (e.g. 'Gen.G (Kills)' vs 'Invictus (Kills)'). In the 2026-10-23T11:42Z snapshot six of eight Worlds picks were taken from the (Kills) market: Gen.G vs Invictus Gaming carried 1.282/3.740 from matchup 1638758865 while the series market 1638748200 was 1.259/3.940. A kills derivative is not a series-winner price. Fixed in this build: tools/collect.py and tools/model.py now reject any participant name containing '(Kills)', 8 derivative markets were excluded, and the 9 remaining market picks are all true series moneylines.
flags.verification: verified live 2026-10-23 (both matchup ids visible in one Pinnacle response)

flags.item: Leaguepedia is community-maintained, not an official league source
flags.detail: Every originated line is fitted on Leaguepedia's community-recorded series history and its Data: page dqteams directives are used to quarantine removed teams. Leaguepedia is not an official settlement authority; Kalshi's own rules, for example, resolve a pre-play forfeit at the fair market price. Forfeit settlement picks on this site are therefore marked conditional.
